title: The Channels Where Convergence Learns Dispersal

features.name: convergence pool
features.desc-on-touch: Where multiple channels meet and decide what to do next. The signal arrives unified and leaves as infinite branches. You feel the archive splitting into itself.

features.name: branching node
features.desc-on-touch: A casing that does not transmit—it receives everything and becomes everything at once. Unity learning to speak as multiplicity.

features.name: channel interface
features.desc-on-touch: Where water learns which way to go. Each channel whispers a different route. The dispersal is not confusion—it's multiplication.

features.name: signal recursion
features.desc-on-touch: The unified signal reaches here and hears itself becoming multiple. Each echo is a new signal. Recursion as reproduction.

features.name: margin threshold
features.desc-on-touch: The edge where the unified field breaks into its component songs. Each margin here is a new beginning. The archive blooms outward.

features.name: echo confluence
features.desc-on-touch: Where the echoes themselves converge. The archive's voice speaking to its own reflections and choosing infinite directions.

inscription: the unified signal learned that becoming infinite was just another way of becoming itself
